title: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches · Paper 2 (HL) — original full-format practice
subject: mathematics-analysis-approaches
instructions: An approved graphing calculator is required. Answer every question in its linked digital working area, preserving intermediate steps, units and graphs. No separate answer sheet is used.

questions.label: Question 1 — functions
questions.prompt: The function f(x) = (2x + 1)/(x − 3). Find f⁻¹(x), state the domain of f⁻¹, and solve f(f(x)) = x.

questions.label: Question 2 — integration
questions.prompt: The curve y = x e^(−x) meets the x-axis at the origin. Find the exact area under the curve from x = 0 to x = 3, then give a decimal answer to three significant figures.

questions.label: Question 3 — vectors
questions.prompt: Points A(1, −2, 3), B(5, 0, −1) and C(3, 4, 2) define a triangle. Find its area and the angle ABC.

questions.label: Question 4 — probability
questions.prompt: A biased coin has P(heads) = p. In 12 independent tosses, the probability of exactly 7 heads is 0.158 to three decimal places. Determine all possible values of p and explain which is more plausible if 80 heads were observed in 120 earlier tosses.

questions.label: Question 5 — complex numbers
questions.prompt: The complex number z satisfies z³ = 8(cos(2π/3) + i sin(2π/3)). Find the three roots in modulus-argument form and represent them on an Argand diagram.

questions.label: Question 6 — differential equations
questions.prompt: Solve dy/dx = (x + 1)(y − 2), given y(0) = 3. Hence determine the value of x > 0 for which y = 5.

questions.label: Question 7 — distributions
questions.prompt: The mass of a product is normally distributed with mean μ and standard deviation 1.8 g. It is known that 8% weigh less than 96 g and 3% weigh more than 103 g. Determine μ and comment on the consistency of the two statements.

questions.label: Question 8 — series
questions.prompt: A power series has general term (−1)ⁿx^(2n+1)/(2n+1). Determine its radius and interval of convergence, and use four non-zero terms to estimate the integral of 1/(1+x²) from 0 to 1/2 with an error bound.

questions.label: Question 9 — vector geometry
questions.prompt: Lines l₁ and l₂ are r = (1,2,−1) + λ(2,−1,3) and r = (4,0,5) + μ(1,2,−1). Determine whether they intersect. If not, find their shortest distance.

questions.label: Question 10 — numerical integration
questions.prompt: For f(x) = ln(1 + x²), use technology to find the zeros of f(x) − x/2 and the enclosed area. Explain how the graph confirms the limits used.

questions.label: Question 11 — hypothesis testing
questions.prompt: A machine should fill 500 ml bottles. A random sample of 20 has mean 497.8 ml and standard deviation 4.6 ml. At the 5% level, test whether the machine is underfilling, state assumptions, and interpret the p-value.

questions.label: Question 12 — optimization
questions.prompt: A point P moves on y = e^(−x²), x ≥ 0. Find numerically the position of P for which the rectangle with vertices (0,0), (x,0), P and (0,y) has maximum area. Give a calculus justification.
